description_en: Calls the BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs operation to configure multiple domain names at a time
description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs实现域名批量配置功能
name: BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following configuration limits:
The product of "Number of domain names" multiplied by "Number of Functions" must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If the number of Functions configured at a time is 20, you can specify only 1 domain name at a time.
If the number of Functions configured at a time is 1, you can specify up to 20 domain names at a time
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名
parameters.name: domain_names
functions
